user.title: Connect to CloudLink
user.description: Enter the CloudLink cloud server URL and your cloud_token (obtained from the cloud server after registering a HA instance).

error.invalid_url: URL must start with http:// or https://

init.title: Domain filter
init.description: Choose whether to exclude selected domains from sync, or only include the selected ones. Informational HA entities (sun, person, weather, etc.) are filtered automatically and never appear here.

data.entity_id_patterns: Exclude entity ID patterns (one fnmatch glob per line, e.g. sensor.backup_* or *_epson_*)
